oma.name: tables
oma.title: Every table at a glance
oma.caption: See which tables are free and who is seated, with what they still owe. Tap a table to see its orders, add more items, move the table or confirm the payment.
oma.alt: OMA on a tablet: the tables grouped by area, free and seated tables marked, with Table T1 selected and its bill and orders shown in the panel on the right.

oma.name: take-order
oma.title: Take the order at the table
oma.caption: Choose dishes by category, pick sizes and add-ons, and add a note for the kitchen. Dishes that are sold out or nearly out are marked, so nobody promises what you can't serve.
oma.alt: OMA on a tablet: the menu with dish photos, prices and Add and Choose buttons on the left, and the order being built, with its total, on the right.

oma.name: orders
oma.title: Every order in one list
oma.caption: Follow each order from new to ready to served. See who ordered, from which table or as a delivery, and what was paid.
oma.alt: OMA on a tablet: the Orders list with each order's number, status, table or delivery, items and amount.

kda.name: board
kda.title: The kitchen board
kda.caption: New orders land on the left the moment they are accepted. Tap Start, then Mark ready. Every ticket shows how long it has waited and changes colour as it does.
kda.alt: KDA on a tablet: the kitchen board with three lanes, New, Preparing and Ready, each holding order tickets with table, guest, dishes and waiting time.

kda.name: prep
kda.title: Prep list
kda.caption: Everything on the board that is not ready yet, added up. The same dish with the same size and add-ons is one line, so the kitchen can cook in batches.
kda.alt: KDA on a tablet: the prep list, each line showing how many of a dish are still to make and across how many orders.

kda.name: dishes
kda.title: Sold out in one tap
kda.caption: Mark a dish sold out, or put it back, in one tap. See at a glance what is off the menu and what is running low for the day.
kda.alt: KDA on a tablet: the dishes list with each dish marked Available or Sold out, a Sold out button beside each, and a dish running low shown as 2 left of 20 a day.

kda.name: today
kda.title: Today at a glance
kda.caption: For kitchen managers: how many orders are made, how long they take on average, which was the slowest, and which dishes went out most.
kda.alt: KDA on a tablet: the Today page with orders by stage right now, orders made, average time, late orders, the slowest order and the most made dishes.

rda.name: deliveries
rda.title: Your deliveries, one by one
rda.caption: Each delivery shows the address, the landmark, how far it is, what is in the bag and whether it is paid. Navigate, call or message the customer with one tap.
rda.alt: RDA on a tablet: the rider's list of deliveries on the way, each with address, distance, customer, items, payment, Navigate, Call and WhatsApp buttons and a Delivered button.

rda.name: pickup
rda.title: Pick up when it is ready
rda.caption: A delivery says Being prepared until the kitchen has finished it. Then it says Ready to pick up, and you tap Picked up to head out.
rda.alt: RDA on a tablet: one delivery marked Ready to pick up with a Picked up button, and one marked Being prepared while the kitchen is still making it.

rda.name: code
rda.title: Hand over with the customer's code
rda.caption: Orders paid online are handed over against the customer's own 4-digit code, so the food reaches the right person.
rda.alt: RDA on a tablet: the box that asks the rider for the customer's 4-digit code before an order can be marked delivered.
